transcript_segments.text: two bodies in a quiet bind one defines the frame of time
i trace a curve i never chose held in paths your mask composed
i was given less to hold less inertia in my roll
every step i try to take turns around you heavy or awake
you don't move the way i do you just star and i accrue
every shift and every bend as if you were origin i revolve
you remain sent to drifts but not for me
i translate you just be
i circle where the balance leans closer in not just between
every arc i try to claim folds back into your domain
not by force i can resist just by scale by what persists
i am pulled into the proof of how much i depend on you
there's a center we both trace head too deep within your space
i can map it i can see it's not place for symmetry
you define the common ground i just trace what falls around
every cycle that i keep writes your name and where i sweep
you don't chase you don't strain
mask decides what aligns i adjust every time
i circle where the balance leans never equal never clean
every path i try to hold tilt toward your manifold
not devotion not a choice just the shape of lesser force
i'm the echo of a frame that was never set the same
you don't need to move to keep me moving
you don't need to call i'm already falling
what we share is not divided it's weighted
what if center isn't mutual just inherited
da
i remain where balance lies even skewed it still survives
not as equal not as free but consistent in its need
i don't fight the way it bends i just follow where it ends
in the orbit i can see you are more than i can ever be
no escape no demand just a curve i understand
not abandoned not undone just the lesser of the suns
thank you for watching
